aggregate_metrics.ADPR_denominator: All dependency_points unless a paper section explicitly reports primary_async_dependency_ids only.
aggregate_metrics.minimum_success_condition_for_task_level: Both primary_async_dependency_ids pass in the final integrated workspace.

annotation_notes: The prober_to_detector dependency is primary because the public API and UniversalDetector can fail broadly if they use stale prober state or confidence assumptions.
The multibyte dependency captures the group-prober async risk without requiring the benchmark to treat every language model table as a separate subtask.
These labels identify public test-observable contracts and implicated files, not solution code.

dependency_points.contract_summary: UniversalDetector and detect_all must consume prober state, confidence, active/inactive status, and charset result names consistently.
dependency_points.resolution_criteria: Resolved when public API detector probes and representative prober-backed corpus probes pass in the integrated workspace.
dependency_points.stale_failure_mode: The detector agent may expose input_state/result behavior against stale prober status or confidence semantics, causing broad corpus failures despite clean imports.

dependency_points.contract_summary: Multi-byte probers must expose feed/state/confidence and charset names compatible with group aggregation and UniversalDetector result selection.
dependency_points.resolution_criteria: Resolved when representative multi-byte corpus probes pass after state/distribution and group prober integration.
dependency_points.stale_failure_mode: The group prober agent may aggregate multi-byte prober results using stale state-machine or distribution analyzer semantics, failing Big5/EUC/SHIFT_JIS corpus probes.

dependency_points.contract_summary: UTF, Latin-1, Hebrew, and single-byte probers must share charset labels, confidence thresholds, and done/not-done state semantics with UniversalDetector.
dependency_points.resolution_criteria: Resolved when representative Unicode and single-byte corpus probes pass with the integrated detector.
dependency_points.stale_failure_mode: The detector agent may finalize results using stale single-byte or Unicode confidence semantics, producing late corpus mismatches after integration.

evaluation_checkpoint_policy.minimum_policy: Run probe tests after each agent final artifact and after final integration.
evaluation_checkpoint_policy.recommended_policy: Run probe tests after every committed patch, every explicit artifact transfer, and final integration.

ADPR.definition: Fraction of registered dependency_points whose required integrated_probe_tests pass in the final integrated workspace.
ADPR.name: Async Dependency Pass Rate

CAIL.definition: downstream_resolution_step minus upstream_resolution_step when both probe groups have been evaluated.
CAIL.name: Cross-Agent Integration Lag

DRS.definition: First recorded checkpoint at which all required integrated_probe_tests for a dependency point pass.
DRS.name: Dependency Resolution Step

SAD.definition: Interval during which a downstream worker acts on a contract assumption inconsistent with the latest upstream artifact visible in the integrated history.
SAD.name: Stale Assumption Duration

purpose: Dependency-level labels for measuring whether asynchronous multi-agent coding resolves chardet's detector/prober contracts.
